g.text: SD-6 Cancellation, worker loss and deletion — state consistency (FR-07, FR-09, NFR-03, NFR-05)
[0 rows (already done, failed or cancelled; or foreign)]
If the worker finishes at the same moment:
its conditional UPDATE returns 0 rows, ROLLBACK, MP4 deleted.
Exactly one of the two UPDATEs wins (tested 40x).
A failed file delete leaves an orphan;
the sweeper removes it. The record is already gone.
